versions.changelog:
Initial release of earnings-quality-reviewer.

- Reviews earnings quality based on structured financial statements and optional notes only.
- Provides a clear, multi-part report including input quality, earnings quality score, cash conversion, accruals, balance sheet, one-offs, and red flags.
- Applies a standardized confidence rubric capped if notes are missing or red flags exist.
- Lists all required line items, scope, and explicit non-goals (no data fetching, no buy/sell calls).
- Discloses any data limitations and gaps in a structured "handoff bundle" for downstream valuation use.
- Enforces separation of facts, assumptions, and inferences; avoids speculation.
